mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% (measured at decision date).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals a tight labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL MoM > 0.5%) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates delayed Fed tightening, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL MoM exceeds 0.5% and FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Supply constraints (INDPRO < 95) suppress industrial output and increase input costs, reducing corporate earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during supply-constrained regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST > 1600.0) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through increased residential investment.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1600.0 units.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS MoM > 100.0k) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a virtuous cycle of labor market strength and consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS MoM exceeds 100.0k and UNRATE remains below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 QoQ > 2.0%) signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained demand momentum.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 QoQ exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.1% MoM) signals imminent monetary tightening, causing short-term equity volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.1% MoM.
